name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3360: run_gates.py carries one why= per gate - a paragraph explaining what a law is for - and _strip_comments cannot touch it because it is a string LITERAL, so the second eye pays full price for it out of a budget that truncates at 9,000 chars. MEASURED on v3354 by share of the 6,844 chars that actually reached the eye: corroborate.py 59.3 percent, run_gates.py 31.5 percent (almost entirely ONE why=), control_app.py 9.2 percent, and tv/second_eye_ledger.py - the file that version exists to change - ZERO. Task 97 found the same shape on v3333 at 44.9 percent, named the cause, and nothing acted on it. Over the last 24 versions the strip recovers 7 changed files that never reached the eye: 65 missed down to 58, 6 versions better, ZERO worse. ⚠⚠ MY FIRST MEASUREMENT SAID IT MADE THREE VERSIONS BLINDER AND THAT WAS MY OWN TOOL, NOT THE IDEA. Collapsing a multi-line why= onto one line pulls the NEXT diff --git off the start of its own line, and every line-anchored reader stops counting a file that is present - for v3346 the header for second_eye_run.py sat at offset 1,362 of a 9,000 cap, EARLIER than before the strip. Preserving the newline count is the whole trick and it is now the first case in the law. That is the third time in this session that an instrument of mine manufactured a finding, and the pattern each time was the same: I read my own artifact as the subject state. ⚠⚠⚠ AND THE LAW CAUGHT A REAL DEFECT IN THE HELPER ON ITS VERY FIRST RUN, which is what a law is for. The pattern allowed an optional paren after the string chunks, so on why="a one line note"), it ATE THE CLOSING PAREN and would have handed the eye a diff whose Gate(...) call no longer closes - the same family as the gate-insert-missing-comma scar, and completely invisible to the file-header count I had been measuring with, because a broken diff still has its diff --git lines. The pattern now touches why= and its string chunks and nothing else; a parenthesised note is left alone, which costs reach and cannot cost correctness. THE 65 TO 58 WAS RE-TAKEN on the narrowed pattern rather than carried over from the measurement of a different one - it came out identical, and that is measured rather than assumed. ⚠ STATED LIMIT, so the saving is not over-read: in a diff every continuation line begins with plus, minus or a space, which the pattern cannot cross, so a five-line note loses its first quoted chunk and keeps the rest. Widening to cross that marker would start eating ordinary string literals in ordinary code and has no measurement behind it at all. ⚠ IT DOES NOT WIDEN THE CAP - v3299 ruled that cost is HIS. This only stops spending the budget on prose. HEART: this version adds no surface, no lane and no store - it improves a measurement that is ALREADY watched end to end, by absent and absentKind on every ledger row since v3349 and v3354, by the partial counter that reads them, and by the second-eye-reach corroborator that puts the stored classification against git. There is nothing here that is newly unsupervised. 479 gates, 5 cases, 3 red-proofs PROVEN.
